headlines.title: China’s factory-gate price growth picks up in August as Iran war fuels energy volatility
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate price growth accelerated in August, while consumer inflation picked up again, amid volatile energy and commodity costs linked to the US-Israel war on Iran.
The producer price index rose 3.8 per cent year on year last month, up from 3.5 per cent in July, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday.
The reading beat a 3.6 per cent projection from economists polled by financial data provider Wind.

headlines.summary: 再度“开闸”不足1月，摊余成本法债基第二批产品已接档上报。9月11日晚间，中国证监会官网显示，13家中小基金公司上报了又一批摊余成本法债基。此次上报的产品均为63个月封闭式的债券型基金，上报的基金公司包括博远基金、瑞达基金、中海基金、泰信基金、汇泉基金、恒越基金、泉果基金、苏新基金、汇百川基金、益民基金。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: New batch of amortized-cost bond funds filed
headlines.summary_en: Less than a month after the restart, the second batch of amortized-cost bond funds has been filed. On the evening of September 11, the CSRC website showed that 13 small and medium-sized fund companies filed another batch of amortized-cost bond funds. All the products filed this time are 63-month closed-end bond funds, and the fund companies include Boyuan Fund, Ruida Fund, Zhonghai Fund, Taixin Fund, Huiquan Fund, Hengyue Fund, Quanguo Fund, Suxin Fund, Huibaichuan Fund and Yimin Fund. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.summary: 过去一周，A股市场维持震荡整理运行格局。中东地缘冲突推升国际油价、美联储9月加息预期快速升温等海外重大宏观事件扰动市场情绪。对此，券商策略展望报告预计，本周美联储议息会议的基础情形是加息25个基点，但这一加息更偏向预防性紧缩，对市场形成短期情绪层面的扰动。待9月美联储议息会议落地，海外不确定性逐步出清后，A股风险偏好有望修复，迎来阶段性转机。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Brokerages: Fed rate hikes lean preventive, A-share risk appetite expected to recover
headlines.summary_en: Over the past week, the A-share market maintained a pattern of volatile consolidation. Major overseas macroeconomic events such as Middle East geopolitical conflicts pushing up international oil prices and rapidly rising expectations for a September Fed rate hike disturbed market sentiment. In response, brokerage strategy outlook reports expect the baseline scenario for this week's Fed meeting to be a 25 basis point hike, but this hike is more of a precautionary tightening and creates short-term sentiment disturbance for the market. After the September Fed meeting concludes and overseas uncertainties are gradually cleared, A-share risk appetite is expected to recover and usher in a phased turnaround. (Shanghai Securities News)

headlines.title_en: Insurance funds channel through private equity funds to increase investment in strategic emerging industries
headlines.summary_en: Recently, two insurance institutions announced new investments in private equity funds, focusing on fields related to national strategic emerging industries such as new energy and advanced manufacturing. Specifically, on September 7, New China Life Insurance Company Ltd. and Brookfield Asset Management held an investment agreement signing ceremony. New China Insurance plans to contribute 4 billion yuan to invest in the Brookfield China New Energy Fund to support China's energy transition and green low-carbon development. Also on September 7, Dajia Life Insurance Co., Ltd. announced the completion of a private equity investment. (Securities Daily)

headlines.title: 上海“明珠星座计划”正式启动，目标建设吉瓦级天基计算星座
headlines.summary: 9月13日，2026浦江创新论坛“太空算力产业生态论坛”在上海举行。“明珠星座计划”正式启动。该计划长期目标是建设吉瓦级天基计算星座，围绕国产算力载荷、光计算载荷、新型能源系统等方向开展在轨验证，随后逐步进入首批卫星部署和规模组网阶段，计划到2030年逐步建成全球覆盖、天地协同、自主可控的太空智能算力基础设施和服务网络。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai's "Mingzhu Constellation Plan" officially launched, aiming to build a gigawatt-level space-based computing constellation
headlines.summary_en: On September 13, the 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum's "Space Computing Power Industry Ecosystem Forum" was held in Shanghai. The "Mingzhu Constellation Plan" was officially launched. The plan's long-term goal is to build a gigawatt-level space-based computing constellation, conducting in-orbit verification in areas such as domestic computing payloads, optical computing payloads, and new energy systems, then gradually entering the initial satellite deployment and large-scale networking stage, with plans to progressively build a globally covered, space-ground coordinated, independently controllable space intelligent computing infrastructure and service network by 2030.

headlines.title: 我国实现一体化算力统筹监测
headlines.summary: 从工业和信息化部了解到，中国算力平台已实现全国一体化算力统筹监测，我国算力“一张网、一盘棋、一体化”发展格局基本形成。中国算力平台是国家级综合性算力服务平台，目前已经汇聚了超万家注册企业用户，上架2000多项优质算力产品，接入各类大模型超300个，为广大开发者提供算力调用服务，累计沉淀数十亿条算力监测大数据。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: China achieves integrated coordinated monitoring of computing power
headlines.summary_en: Learned from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology that China's computing power platform has achieved nationwide integrated computing power coordinated monitoring, and the development pattern of "one network, one chessboard, integration" for China's computing power has basically taken shape. China's computing power platform is a national-level comprehensive computing power service platform. It has currently gathered more than 10,000 registered enterprise users, listed more than 2,000 high-quality computing power products, connected more than 300 large models of various types, provided computing power invocation services for developers, and accumulated billions of pieces of computing power monitoring big data. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 新品密集发布，光通信业技术迭代速度超预期
headlines.summary: “以往做光电产业的都是苦哈哈的，遇上AI如生双翼！”在日前举行的第二十七届中国国际光电博览会上，有业内人士感慨道。本届光博会上，多家上市公司及科创企业携年度重磅产品、突破性技术方案集中亮相。从最上游的激光芯片到光引擎、光纤光缆，再到交换系统等环节，围绕AI算力密集刷新技术指标，代际跃迁速度明显加快。谈及投资者对AI增长的担忧，上述业内人士表示，AI投资回报闭环已显现，现在唯一不确定的是哪一条技术路径是最终方案，但目前所有的技术路径都能找到适合的应用场景。（上证报）

headlines.title_en: Frequent new product launches, optical communication industry technology iteration speed exceeds expectations
headlines.summary_en: "In the past, those in the optoelectronics industry had a hard time, but with AI it's like growing wings!" an industry insider lamented at the recently held 27th China International Optoelectronic Exposition. At this year's CIOE, many listed companies and sci-tech innovation enterprises unveiled their major annual products and breakthrough technology solutions. From the most upstream laser chips to optical engines, optical fiber and cable, and then to switching systems and other links, technical indicators are being intensively refreshed around AI computing power, and the pace of generational leaps has clearly accelerated. Regarding investors' concerns about AI growth, the industry insider said the closed loop of AI investment returns has already emerged, and the only uncertainty now is which technological path is the final solution, but currently all technological paths can find suitable application scenarios. (Shanghai Securities News)
